pairs.advice: the pair trades wider than the round-trip toll on almost every session: this is a standing condition, so the swap is a permanent re-tickering and there is nothing to watch between decision bars

the gap does not clear the round-trip toll: swapping would pay more to move than it saves, so the trigger is the gap itself (re-read on the next decision bar)

recheck_rule: any bar inside the grid works: the gap is not a perishable tail (one-off part 6,845 CNY). After execution the only number that can bring the decision back is the round-trip toll: re-read this face on the next decision bar, and act again only if a pair's gap exceeds 0.16 pp (2 x 8 bp per side).
caveats: the trigger is priced in pp of notional and compared against the round-trip cost only; it does not price tracking difference, fee, size or FX-hedge policy between the two tickers
episode lengths are measured on the reconstructed gap, which inherits the single IOPV anchor of the gap face; censored episodes are reported, never scored as zero
a 'window always open' reading means the pair is structurally wide, not that the swap has to be repeated: the book only has to hold it once
